The decisive mistake was the Assistant's script at step 59. It filtered the raw World Bank CSV with `(x > 35).all()` across 2001-2010, without excluding aggregate rows such as "East Asia & Pacific (IDA & IBRD countries)", without handling missing values, and without checking the output against the data. Those choices produced the wrong list, which the Orchestrator then accepted at step 64 without catching the aggregates. That acceptance was a contributing error, but the faulty computation originated in the Assistant's script.
